item.title: Uber ridesharing gets Knesset nod in rare vote
item.description: The Knesset has taken a major step toward modernizing Israel's transit sector, approving a bill to regulate ridesharing apps like Uber in a preliminary reading. The legislation, a bipartisan effort, promises to open the market to competition while safeguarding veteran taxi drivers through a compensation fund.
